title: Canonical Wnt signaling promotes HSC glycolysis and liver fibrosis through an LDH-A/HIF-1alpha transcriptional complex.
authors: Wang, Feixia; Chen, Li; Kong, Desong; Zhang, Xiaojin; Xia, Siwei; Liang, Baoyu; Li, Yang; Zhou, Ya; Zhang, Zili; Shao, Jiangjuan; Zheng, Shizhong; Zhang, Feng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Wnt信号调控HSC糖酵解及LDH-A/HIF-1alpha转录复合物在肝纤维化中的作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA转录调控但非TF-DNA结合建模核心，方法以实验为主，仅含分子模拟，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Aerobic glycolysis reprogramming occurs during HSC activation, but how it is initiated and sustained remains unknown. We investigated the mechanisms by which canonical Wnt signaling regulated HSC glycolysis and the therapeutic implication for liver fibrosis. APPROACH AND RESULTS: Glycolysis was examined in HSC-LX2 cells upon manipulation of Wnt/beta-catenin signaling. Nuclear translocation of lactate dehydrogenase A (LDH-A) and its interaction with hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) were investigated using molecular simulation and site-directed mutation assays. The pharmacological relevance of molecular discoveries was intensified in primary cultures, rodent models, and human samples. HSC glycolysis was enhanced by Wnt3a but reduced by beta-catenin inhibitor or small interfering RNA (siRNA). Wnt3a-induced rapid transactivation and high expression of LDH-A dependent on TCF4. Wnt/beta-catenin signaling also stimulated LDH-A nuclear translocation through importin beta2 interplay with a noncanonical nuclear location signal of LDH-A. Mechanically, LDH-A bound to HIF-1alpha and enhanced its stability by obstructing hydroxylation-mediated proteasome degradation, leading to increased transactivation of glycolytic genes. The Gly28 residue of LDH-A was identified to be responsible for the formation of the LDH-A/HIF-1alpha transcription complex and stabilization of HIF-1alpha. Furthermore, LDH-A-mediated glycolysis was required for HSC activation in the presence of Wnt3a. Results in vivo showed that HSC activation and liver fibrosis were alleviated by HSC-specific knockdown of LDH-A in mice. beta-catenin inhibitor XAV-939 mitigated HSC activation and liver fibrosis, which were abrogated by HSC-specific LDH-A overexpression in mice with fibrosis. CONCLUSIONS: Inhibition of HSC glycolysis by targeting Wnt/beta-catenin signaling and LDH-A had therapeutic promise for liver fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：有氧糖酵解重编程发生在肝星状细胞（HSC）活化过程中，但其启动和维持机制尚不清楚。我们研究了经典Wnt信号调控HSC糖酵解的机制及其对肝纤维化的治疗意义。方法与结果：在HSC-LX2细胞中，通过调控Wnt/β-catenin信号检测糖酵解水平。利用分子模拟和定点突变实验，研究了乳酸脱氢酶A（LDH-A）的核转位及其与缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）的相互作用。分子发现的药理学相关性在原代培养、啮齿动物模型和人类样本中得到加强。Wnt3a增强HSC糖酵解，而β-catenin抑制剂或小干扰RNA（siRNA）则降低糖酵解。Wnt3a诱导的LDH-A快速反式激活和高表达依赖于TCF4。Wnt/β-catenin信号还通过importin beta2与LDH-A非经典核定位信号的相互作用刺激LDH-A核转位。机制上，LDH-A与HIF-1α结合，并通过阻碍羟基化介导的蛋白酶体降解增强其稳定性，从而增加糖酵解基因的反式激活。LDH-A的Gly28残基被鉴定为负责LDH-A/HIF-1α转录复合物的形成及HIF-1α的稳定化。此外，在Wnt3a存在下，LDH-A介导的糖酵解是HSC活化所必需的。体内结果显示，小鼠中HSC特异性敲低LDH-A可减轻HSC活化和肝纤维化。β-catenin抑制剂XAV-939缓解了HSC活化和肝纤维化，但在纤维化小鼠中，HSC特异性过表达LDH-A则消除了这些效应。结论：通过靶向Wnt/β-catenin信号和LDH-A抑制HSC糖酵解对肝纤维化具有治疗前景。
